purpose: List demands or topics with a sense that there are too many.
keywords: やれ + item / clause + やれ + item / clause
It is meetings, business trips, one thing after another; I cannot settle down.
They keep demanding that it be cheaper, faster, and so on.
He is forever complaining that it is too hot, too cold, and so on.
formation: やれ + item / clause + やれ + item / clause
restrictions: Often reports other people’s demands or a hectic assortment.
mistake: The repeated やれ is a listing device, not an instruction to do something.
